title: Validate reserves and draft filing narrative with Claude for Excel
surface: Cowork + Claude for Excel + Claude for Word
description: Cowork reads your reserve workbook from the valuation folder and pulls prior filings and bulletins through the NAIC connector. You take the formula flags and reserve walk into Claude for Excel to clean the workbook, then bring the narrative into Claude for Word for the filing memo.
prompt: Q1 reserve review for Personal Auto BI — appointed actuary review next week, filing due in two. Walk me through the workbook before I lock the numbers.
steps: Read the reserve workbook in the valuation folder and validate the formulas
Pull the FY24 filing and any new bulletins from NAIC
Flag development factors and tail assumptions that look off vs. prior
Give a brief for Excel with sheet references, what's broken, and what's just a movement to explain
prerequisites: Valuation folder with reserve workbook attached
